text.arabic_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating connector that carries the proof-frame forward without making the luminary clause a causal sequel
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the ayah inside the created-heavens proof rather than launching an isolated astronomy statement. Its force is additive and resumptive, while local sequence blocks a causal or circumstantial reading. The one-letter onset compresses that transition before the first making verb arrives.

topics.headline: opening connector extends the previous proof-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the luminary clauses as continuation of the layered-heavens proof, not as a detached new topic.
topics.reason: The opening particle precedes the first perfect verb and attachment evidence places the clause after the creation-proof question of 71:15.

topics.headline: coordination without causal sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is joined as cumulative evidence, not as a caused next step or a circumstantial aside.
topics.reason: The following perfect verb licenses resumptive coordination; no local marker requires a causal {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) or circumstantial reading.

topics.headline: single-letter transition beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a whole discourse transition carried by one compact attached particle.
topics.reason: The particle is a one-letter proclitic attached to the following verbal clause on the surface.

words.gloss_range: completed divine rendering or appointing in a double-complement frame: the moon is made a light-role, not merely manufactured or placed
words.root_gloss_range: making, rendering, appointing, placing, and causing; locally the object-plus-predicate frame selects rendering or assigning a function, while inceptive and intensive branches are not selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first object receiving the assigned role
the second complement naming the lunar light-function

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) opens the first luminary clause as a completed act of assignment: the known moon is given the predicate {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}), so the grammar presents lunar light as a conferred role. The implied active subject is recoverable from the previous ayah, but the surface keeps attention on the object-predicate relation. This first verb also sets the template later repeated for the sun, so the contrast will fall on the predicates rather than on agency; the same making frame recalls the sun-moon role assignment (10:5) and belongs to the surah's broader ordering thread that returns with the earth (71:19).

topics.headline: double-complement frame assigns lunar function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon receives a role-predicate; it is not simply named beside light.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) and {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}) as the two accusative complements of {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}).

topics.headline: active perfect with recoverable divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the cosmic arrangement as settled divine ordering even though the subject is not overtly repeated.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a 3ms active perfect verb, and attachment evidence resolves the omitted subject through the discourse antecedent from 71:15.

topics.headline: rendering sense excludes inceptive or intensive alternatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the positive appointment sense while avoiding readings that would turn the clause into beginning, repeated apportionment, or an agent-title construction.
topics.reason: The local complements are nouns, not a following imperfect verb, and the surface is finite Form I {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}).

topics.headline: first verb establishes the paired clause pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first making-clause as a template whose repetition will make moon and sun comparable before their functions diverge.
topics.reason: The same finite verb recurs at word 7, while each clause has its own object and predicate complement.

topics.headline: making root joins celestial roles to broader ordering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common making verb becomes locally patterned by repeated assignments of created order, including the sun-moon role frame (10:5) and the earth-ordering return (71:19).
topics.reason: Contextual profiles show {{ar:ج ع ل}} ({{tr:j-ʿ-l}}) as common, but the CRITICAL rows point to concrete local recurrence and named parallels, so the payoff is patterning rather than rarity.

words.gloss_range: the definite known moon as a concrete celestial body receiving a light-function inside the heavens
words.root_gloss_range: moon, moonlit brightness, pale or cool visibility; locally the concrete lunar body is selected, while brightness derivatives color the assigned light role without replacing the noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the predicate role assigned to the moon
the paired definite luminary in the second clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) is fixed first as the familiar moon, then located and assigned its role. The definite accusative object remains the celestial body, while {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}) names the function it receives; this keeps body and light from collapsing into one label. Its pairing with {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) makes a local dyad, but the intervening locative and the different predicate keep the moon's role distinct. The moon-light formula is familiar from role and quality parallels (10:5; 25:61), and the hamzat-waṣl flow binds the verb tightly to the moon before location and predicate arrive.

topics.headline: definite moon receives a predicate role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the moon as the known object receiving light-function, not as an appositional synonym for light.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) as the first accusative object of the first {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) clause.

topics.headline: lunar body with cool visibility pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps a cool moonlit-visibility field around the noun while local grammar still selects the concrete moon as body.
topics.reason: The object slot selects the celestial body; root-family brightness derivatives remain image pressure for the later predicate rather than making the noun itself mean light.

topics.headline: definite singular object anchors the visible moon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof points to the recognizable moon, while gender difference from the sun does not break their shared object slot.
topics.reason: The form is definite singular accusative, parallel in syntactic role to {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}).

topics.headline: local dyad with distributed predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees moon and sun as a recognized pair whose grammar is shared before their functions are split.
topics.reason: The ayah places two definite accusative luminaries in repeated making-clauses, with distinct predicates assigned to each.

topics.headline: moon-light formula is localized inside the heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar moon-light association (10:5; 25:61) is here pulled into the layered-heavens frame by the intervening locative.
topics.reason: The row evidence gives concrete parallels, while attachment evidence resolves {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}) to the heavens from 71:15.

topics.headline: recitation binds verb and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the moon tied tightly to the making verb before the predicate arrives.
topics.reason: The hamzat-waṣl surface allows close recitational continuation from {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) into {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}).

words.gloss_range: locative preposition plus feminine plural suffix: within them, referring back to the heavens of 71:15 and inserting that domain into the moon clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the lunar object whose assignment is located in that domain
the delayed predicate named after the locative phrase

words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}) is the grammatical bridge back to the heavens of 71:15. The preposition gives containment, and the feminine plural suffix makes the previous layered architecture necessary for reading this ayah. By standing between {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) and {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}), it delays the predicate so the moon's light is first placed inside that inherited cosmic domain.

topics.headline: feminine plural suffix resumes the heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader has to carry the seven-heavens frame from 71:15 into the moon clause instead of reading the ayah in isolation.
topics.reason: Attachment cross-reference evidence resolves the 3fp suffix in {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}) to the feminine plural heavens in 71:15.

topics.headline: containment and domain membership, not instrumentality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates the lunar assignment within the heavens as a domain, without turning the heavens into the means by which the moon shines.
topics.reason: The preposition {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs the suffix as a locative complement in the first making-clause.

topics.headline: locative insertion delays the light predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences location before function: the moon is placed within the inherited heavens before its light-role is named.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase stands between the first object {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) and the predicate complement {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}).

topics.headline: layered heavens become functioning cosmic space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from the architecture of the heavens to the luminaries functioning inside them.
topics.reason: The boundary reference links the previous description of layered heavens with the internal placement of lunar light in this clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative predicate assigning the moon a visible light-function as effect, not source-instrument or burning fire
words.root_gloss_range: light, illumination, manifest visibility, and related brightening; locally the noun predicate selects visible illumination for the moon, distinct from lamp-source and fire imagery

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite bearer of the light predicate
the locative insertion before the lunar predicate

words.prose: {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}) completes the first clause by naming the moon's assigned function as light. Its indefinite accusative form classifies a role for the definite moon, while the lexical contrast with {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) keeps lunar illumination as manifested light rather than lamp-source. The moon-light recurrence (10:5; 25:61) is specialized here by placement after {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}), so the first beat resolves only after the moon has been situated within the heavens; the softer nasal cadence after the suffix helps the lunar closure feel lighter before the later lamp word.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate classifies lunar light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees light as the function assigned to the moon, not the moon's total identity or a second object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}) as the second complement of the first {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) clause.

topics.headline: visible illumination rather than lamp-source or fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon is assigned manifested illumination, while source-instrument and fire-like force are reserved elsewhere.
topics.reason: The local predicate is the noun {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}), contrasted in the ayah with {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}); broader brightening derivatives remain pressure, not a causative verb reading.

topics.headline: moon-light recurrence specialized by the locative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the moon-light formula (10:5; 25:61) while seeing that 71:16 locates it inside the layered heavens.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows give concrete moon-light parallels, and local syntax inserts {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}) before the predicate.

topics.headline: first luminary beat resolves in soft light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the first beat close with a softer light predicate that will be balanced against the later lamp predicate.
topics.reason: The predicate follows the locative insertion and shares accusative indefiniteness with the later {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}), while sound rows mark the lighter nasal cadence.

words.gloss_range: internal coordinating connector joining the sun clause to the moon clause as a counterpart, not a causal or temporal sequel
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots inside the ayah from the moon assignment to the sun assignment. Unlike the opening connector, its main scope is local: it joins two peer clauses and invites comparison. The repeated one-letter connector keeps the second beat visibly and audibly dependent on the first without making the sun follow from the moon.

topics.headline: mid-ayah connector pairs the two clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the sun clause as the moon clause's counterpart, not as a new independent proof or a consequence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) clause as coordinated with the first by {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}).

topics.headline: same one-letter connector returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's two transitions handled by the same compact particle, first at the boundary and then inside the pair.
topics.reason: The written and recited surface repeats the one-letter connector before each making-clause.

words.gloss_range: second completed divine rendering in the paired frame: the sun is appointed as a lamp-like source, parallel in agency but distinct in predicate
words.root_gloss_range: making, rendering, appointing, placing, and causing; locally the repeated object-plus-predicate frame selects appointed solar source-function and excludes inceptive or intensive alternatives

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the object receiving the lamp predicate
the second complement naming solar lamp-function
the locative phrase present in the moon clause but absent from the sun clause

words.prose: The second {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) repeats the completed assignment frame for the sun. The implied agent and perfect aspect match the moon clause, so the luminaries are equalized under divine ordering; the difference falls on {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) against {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}). Because this clause has no intervening {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}), it moves directly from the sun to lamp-status and makes solar function immediate. The plain lamp predicate identifies source-role here, while the related cosmic lamp can be intensified elsewhere (78:13) or placed in the sky-domain more generally (25:61).

topics.headline: repeated frame assigns lamp-status to the sun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees lamp-status as an assigned role of the sun, not as an independent object or mythic solar agency.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) and {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) as the object and predicate complement of the second {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}).

topics.headline: solar rendering excludes inceptive or intensive alternatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the appointed source-function while avoiding readings that turn the verb into beginning, repeated fabrication, or an agent-title construction.
topics.reason: The second verb has nominal complements and remains finite Form I {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}), matching the first clause.

topics.headline: same verb makes predicates carry contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repetition holds agency constant so the semantic work shifts to moon-light versus sun-lamp.
topics.reason: The two clauses repeat the same verb while changing object, predicate, and presence of the locative insertion.

topics.headline: lamp parallels identify source-role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the plain lamp predicate as source-identification, especially against the intensified blazing lamp in 78:13 and the cosmic lamp in 25:61.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) parallels, and local grammar ties the predicate directly to {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}).

words.gloss_range: the definite known sun as concrete solar body receiving the lamp-source predicate directly
words.root_gloss_range: sun, solar exposure, heat, glare, and drying force; locally the concrete sun is selected, while exposure and heat pressure support the lamp-source predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired definite luminary in the first clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) is the familiar sun in the same object slot that the moon occupied, but it moves directly to {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}). The feminine object and masculine noun predicate do not have adjectival agreement; the grammar classifies the solar body by lamp-function. The root-field of exposure and glare supports the stronger source image, while the definite singular keeps the focus on the recognizable sun rather than a class of suns. The sun-assignment formula has wider parallels (10:5; 6:96), but this clause concretizes radiance as lamp-source, and the article's sun-letter assimilation gives the solar noun a tighter onset than the moon's.

topics.headline: definite feminine object receives masculine noun predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sun classified by a noun predicate, not modified by an adjective requiring agreement.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) as definite feminine accusative, while {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) is an indefinite noun predicate.

topics.headline: solar body carries heat and glare pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels why the sun can receive the lamp-source predicate: the solar body already carries exposure, heat, and glare pressure.
topics.reason: Local grammar selects the concrete solar body, while root-family exposure derivatives remain supporting pressure for {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}), not separate actions.

topics.headline: paired objects diverge by predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a familiar sun-moon dyad whose shared grammar prevents flattening both luminaries into generic brightness.
topics.reason: Both luminaries are definite accusative objects in parallel making-clauses, but the predicates divide their functions.

topics.headline: sun radiance is concretized as lamp-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun-function formula seen in 10:5 and 6:96 is specialized here through lamp imagery rather than left as general radiance.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows name concrete parallels, while local predicate choice is {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}), not the radiance term used in 10:5.

topics.headline: sun moves directly to lamp predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the solar source-role arrive without the locative delay that shaped the moon clause.
topics.reason: The second clause lacks an intervening {{ar:فِيهِنَّ}} ({{tr:fīhinna}}) between object and predicate.

topics.headline: sun-letter assimilation tightens the onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the article fuse into the solar noun more tightly than the moon's lunar-letter onset.
topics.reason: The shaddah in {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) marks sun-letter assimilation after the article.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative predicate classifying the sun as a concrete lamp-like source and closing the ayah with source imagery
words.root_gloss_range: lamp, luminous instrument, lighting or equipping apparatus, with fitting imagery in the wider family; locally the concrete cosmic lamp noun is selected, not an active lighting verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite sun classified by the lamp predicate

words.prose: {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) completes the ayah by classifying the sun as a lamp-like source. Its accusative indefiniteness makes it the predicate assigned to {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}), not a second object, and its concrete lamp imagery differs sharply from lunar {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}). Because the word is rare, concrete, and final, it joins a small cosmic lamp set (25:61; 78:13) and makes sourcehood the ayah's closing impression. The shared tanwīn ending binds the two predicates as a pair, while the harder final texture of the lamp word marks the shift from soft light to concrete source.

topics.headline: second accusative names lamp-status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees lamp as the function assigned to the sun, not as another object or an adjective agreeing with the feminine noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}) as the second complement of the second {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) clause.

topics.headline: lamp noun gives prepared source imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun is made a concrete luminous instrument, not just an abstract radiance or independent lighting agent.
topics.reason: The selected local form is the noun {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}); equipping and fitting branches remain apparatus pressure while active-participle or verb readings are not selected.

topics.headline: rare cosmic lamp set sharpens the word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this as part of a small cosmic lamp set (25:61; 78:13), which makes the predicate distributionally weighty.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks {{ar:س ر ج}} ({{tr:s-r-j}}) as low-occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows give concrete cosmic parallels.

topics.headline: final word completes source/effect contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah land on the sun as source, completing the moon-light versus sun-lamp distribution.
topics.reason: The final predicate completes the second clause and closes the paired structure after {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}) closed the first beat.

topics.headline: cadence binds and differentiates the predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two tanwīn predicates as a pair while the harder final texture of the lamp word marks a stronger source image.
topics.reason: Both predicates share accusative tanwīn, while the sound rows contrast the softer {{ar:نُورًۭا}} ({{tr:nūran}}) closure with {{ar:سِرَاجًۭا}} ({{tr:sirājan}}).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ja'ala frames the non-identical predicates al-qamar/nuran and al-shams/sirajan.
baseline_models.mechanism: Parallel syntax assigns complementary luminous functions rather than merely listing two bright objects: the moon is made a field or effect of illumination, while the sun is figured as a shining lamp-like apparatus.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies the functional predication performed twice.
The moon and its sky-light identify the first luminous body and effect.
Light and illumination define the first assigned state as luminous presence.
Sun and daylight supply the second luminous body and its radiating regime.
The shining lamp casts solar radiance as an emitting apparatus rather than a synonym for nur.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply says that the moon and sun both shine.
changed_reading.after: The repeated making assigns differentiated roles: lunar illumination is a luminous presence within the heavens, while solar radiance is lamp-like and source-shaped.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ja'ala, fihinna, nur, and siraj combine production, interior location, and a familiar lighting implement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heavens read as a designed environment rather than empty extension. A lunar light-marker is installed within them and a solar lamp furnishes the larger scene.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or making into being supplies the constructive frame for the paired furnishings.
Beacon, landmark, and lamp-stand make the lunar light an installed marker within the heavens.
The shining lamp supplies the concrete furnishing analogy for the sun.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories two celestial objects.
changed_reading.after: It presents a deliberately furnished luminous environment, with an internal beacon and a lamp-like source.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The moon/light and sun/lamp clauses form a balanced pair whose lexical branches distinguish moonlit and daylight activity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Moonlit approach or activity and solar daylight define two temporal regimes. Their coordination makes illumination continuous in coverage but modulated in form and intensity.

activation_trace.role: Approaching or hunting by moonlight gives the lunar clause a nocturnal activity regime.
Illumination is the common function that continues across the paired regimes.
Sun and daylight establish the overt diurnal counterpart.
The shining lamp gives the daylight regime concentrated radiance.

changed_reading.before: Moon and sun are two examples of brightness.
changed_reading.after: They form complementary nocturnal and diurnal regimes whose different lights provide continuous coverage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Nur and siraj are predicated of named bodies rather than appearing as unlocated abstractions.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible moon-marker within the heavens and a shining solar lamp make the celestial arrangement legible and orienting; luminosity marks position and relation, not only brightness.

activation_trace.role: The moon and its sky-light provide the located body that carries the marker.
Beacon and landmark turn light into an orienting sign.
The shining lamp supplies a second visible reference point with stronger radiance.

changed_reading.after: They also make the heavens readable as an oriented field of located markers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus arrangement becomes the visible middle of an epistemic sequence: disclosure and knowledge lead into the command to reflect on creation, with reverent weight as the missing response. The lights therefore orient judgment as well as space.

activation_trace.role: Revealing meaning by speech or sign makes the celestial contrast legible disclosure.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive uptake expected from the visible arrangement.
Dignified gravity supplies the affective and ethical response that perception should produce.
Reflective seeing directly frames the following moon and sun as material for thought.
The beacon-like light is the focus sign that makes order perceptible.
The shining lamp supplies the conspicuous second term of the visual argument.

structural_cues: 71:13 asks about absent reverence, 71:15 asks whether they have seen how creation is arranged, and 71:16 supplies a balanced visible example.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, knowing, reflective seeing, reverent weight, and the luminous pair; I infer a perception-to-recognition arrow. A live alternative is that the luminaries are only one independent example in a catalogue of signs.

changed_reading.before: The moon and sun are orienting celestial markers.
changed_reading.after: Their differentiated visibility is also an argument meant to disclose order, engage reflection, and produce moral weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night/day and public/secret form two exhaustive communication binaries. The moon/light and sun/lamp pair becomes their cosmic analogue: distinct channels maintain address across changing times and degrees of visibility.

activation_trace.role: Calling and drawing by speech supplies the communicative process whose coverage is being varied.
Night and its darkness establish the first temporal channel.
Day opening in light establishes the complementary overt channel.
Public declaration and raised voice give the daylight-like channel social visibility.
Concealment in the interior gives the moonlit channel its private counterpart.
Moonlit activity anchors the nocturnal side of the communicative analogy.
Sun and daylight anchor the public diurnal side.
The shining lamp intensifies the image of manifest address.

structural_cues: 71:5 pairs night and day; 71:8-9 then pairs public and secret calling before 71:16 repeats ja'ala around moon and sun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two exhaustive communicative binaries and two complementary luminaries; I infer that the latter figures the former's persistence across channels. The live alternative is parallel but independent rhetoric of comprehensiveness.

changed_reading.before: Moon and sun provide complementary nocturnal and diurnal illumination.
changed_reading.after: Their complementary luminosities also stage an address that persists across night/day and concealed/public modes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same state-making verb appears when people turn fingers into ear-stoppers, then clothing into cover and persistence into a knot. The focus's divine making of light and lamp becomes the positive half of a design conflict: ordered creation enables reception while human counter-design disables it.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state marks the human repurposing of fingers as barriers.
Listening and accepting what is heard identify the reception channel being blocked.
A covering laid over something supplies the deliberate occlusion mechanism.
Clothing, also a metonym for the self, becomes the material used to withdraw from reception.
Persistence and resolve lock the improvised barrier into a maintained stance.
The repeated divine state-assignment answers the earlier human state-assignment at a cosmic scale.
Illumination supplies the availability that human coverings attempt to defeat.
The shining lamp represents purposive provision for visibility.

structural_cues: 71:7 compresses making, ear-blocking, self-covering, and persistence into one refusal scene; 71:16 answers with a doubled making of luminous functions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated verb and a concrete reception barrier; I infer an opposition between design and counter-design. The live alternative is that 71:7 is only behavioral description and does not formally contrast with cosmic making.

changed_reading.before: The Maker furnishes the heavens with visibility.
changed_reading.after: The luminous furnishing is contested: divine making opens a field for reception while human making repurposes body and clothing to close it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence sends abundant water, extends resources, forms rivers, and brings growth from earth. That flow activates the moon root's water-and-pasture abundance and nur's blossom branch, recasting the focus pair as participants or markers in a connected provisioning ecology.

activation_trace.role: Sending and emission initiate the downward provisioning flow.
A river cutting the ground with running water supplies the network's channel.
Abundant outflow from a source gives the network its sustained material movement.
Connected increase that supplies another element links flow to accumulating provision.
Planting and cultivation supply the terrestrial output of the flow.
The moon root's abundance of water and pasture lets the lunar member join the provisioning image.
Tree blossom and bloom connect light to the visible emergence of growth.
The shining lamp supplies concentrated energy imagery within the provisioning system.

structural_cues: 71:11-12 moves from sky-sent abundance to wealth, gardens, and rivers; 71:16 inserts the luminaries before human growth from earth in 71:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a water-resource-growth sequence plus lunar abundance and light-as-blossom branches; I infer ecological participation or regulation by the luminaries. A live alternative is that these are adjacent provisions with no causal link to light.

changed_reading.before: The moon and sun furnish the heavens with light.
changed_reading.after: They can also be read inside a flow network whose sky, water, luminosity, and growth jointly provision terrestrial life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stages and superposed layers precede the focus; human sprouting, return into earth, and emergence follow it. The assigned luminous roles occupy the hinge between upper layering and lower transformation, making them phase-markers within a nested creation cycle.

activation_trace.role: Successive stages supply the temporal logic of transformation.
Layers above one another supply the upper spatial architecture that contains the moon.
Human growth and formation transfer staged development to the terrestrial side.
The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the mirrored container for human growth and return.
Return after departure converts linear growth into a cycle.
Bringing a thing out from concealment supplies the cycle's renewed emergence.
Repeated state-assignment places both luminaries inside the staged mechanism.
The moon located within the heavens occupies the upper side of the nested cycle.
Illumination supplies a visible marker of changing stages.

structural_cues: 71:14 gives stages, 71:15 gives layered heavens, 71:16 installs lights, and 71:17-18 gives growth, return, and extraction from earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact stages-layers-lights-growth-return sequence; I infer that the luminaries mark or mediate phase changes. The live alternative is a serial catalogue of creations with no process arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: The lights are static installations in a layered sky.
changed_reading.after: They become a luminous hinge between layered formation above and cyclical growth, return, and emergence below.

context_deltas.mechanism: A lamp overhead, an earth made into a spread carpet, broad routes through it, and the final inhabited house form one scaled material analogy. The focus does not merely light space; it helps furnish a traversable dwelling.

activation_trace.role: State-assignment makes earth function as a spread floor, echoing the focus's assigned lights.
Earth as an outspread carpet supplies the dwelling's floor.
Penetrating along a path makes the furnished space usable in motion.
Extended roads organize circulation across the floor.
Wide openings between heights give the dwelling large corridors.
Shelter and dwelling contract the cosmic furnishing image into an inhabited house.
Beacon and lamp-stand furnish orientation inside the scaled dwelling.
The shining lamp supplies the dwelling's overhead light.

structural_cues: 71:16's lamp precedes 71:19's earth-carpet and 71:20's roads; 71:28 closes with entry into the speaker's house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lamp, carpet, routes, and house; I infer one habitation frame scaled from cosmos to household. A live alternative is that these are separate accessibility metaphors rather than one dwelling mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are furnished with celestial light.
changed_reading.after: The whole created field reads as a furnished, traversable dwelling: lamp above, spread floor below, corridors across it, and households within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context repeatedly varies covering: forgiveness protects, garments block, gardens conceal by growth, heaven-layers cover one another, and disbelief covers truth. Because the moon is made light within those layers, light is not simply the opposite of cover; it tests whether a covering shelters, cultivates, transmits, or refuses.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the beneficial form of concealment.
A cover laid over the self supplies deliberate blockage.
Concealment underlies the garden image and supplies a cover that can cultivate life.
One matching layer covering another supplies the material envelope named by fihinna.
Covering and concealment supply the ethically closed form of the same material action.
State-assignment places luminosity inside rather than outside the layered environment.
Illumination supplies what the different coverings preserve, transmit, or suppress.

structural_cues: The focus says the moon is light fihinna, inside the layered heavens named in 71:15, while covering vocabulary recurs in protective, vegetal, resistant, and ethical settings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several branch-specific coverings and light located within layers; I infer a functional typology based on permeability and purpose. The live alternative is unrelated root polysemy whose only commonality is English 'covering.'

changed_reading.after: Light can inhabit layers, so the decisive contrast is between covers that shelter or cultivate luminosity and covers that suppress reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence reverses medium and function: drowning is followed by entry into fire, and the packet maps that fire occurrence to the same root inventory whose focus branch is illumination. The benign nur/siraj pair acquires a contained combustion edge without being identified with the punishment.

activation_trace.role: Drowning in water supplies the first medium in the abrupt reversal.
Entry into an interior turns the following fire into an encompassing destination.
Burning fire and branding activate the combustible branch of the focus light-root inventory.
Light and illumination supply the beneficial focus pole of the shared inventory.
The shining lamp makes fuel-like combustion latent in the image while its focus function remains illumination.

structural_cues: 71:16 joins nur to a lamp; 71:25 moves directly from drowning to entry into fire and supplies the packet's fire branch for the same mapped root inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, lamp, drowning, entry, and burning-fire branches; I infer a retrospective illumination-versus-combustion polarity. The live alternative is to keep nur and nar contextually separate despite their packet mapping and shared inventory.

changed_reading.before: The luminous pair is an unambiguously benign provision.
changed_reading.after: Its semantic field now holds a controlled polarity: ordered radiance illuminates, while the later fire scene exposes combustion as luminosity's dangerous material edge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the non-luminous shams branch of animal restiveness with the sarj branch of saddle gear. It remains anchored in the exact focus words and ja'ala's state-making, while context obedience, flight, and disobedience sharpen the contrast. Downstream prose must present it as branch resonance, not as a translation of siraj or an astronomical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ja'ala al-shamsa sirajan can, at branch distance, sound like a restive force being made serviceable or saddled.

activation_trace.role: Obedient yielding supplies the governing relation against which restiveness is measured.
Flight supplies the human refusal that contrasts with cosmic serviceability.
Departure from obedience confirms the social restiveness side of the contrast.
Turning into a state supplies the act of making power function in an assigned role.
Restive refusal and difficult temper supply the force imagined as requiring harness.
Saddle and mounting gear supply the exploratory image of harnessed service.

changed_reading.before: The sun is made a shining lamp.
changed_reading.after: At a contained lexical distance, cosmic power appears harnessed into service while the human community remains restive and disobedient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates bewildering whiteness and misleading-light branches against the focus's ordinary positive luminosity. It remains anchored in qamar, nur, shams, and the nearby seeing frame, with context glare and misguidance supplying a coherent perceptual mechanism. Downstream prose should call it a warning about uncalibrated perception, never a claim that the verse labels its lights deceptive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qamar, nur, and shams carry branch images in which intense visibility can bewilder or mislead as well as reveal.

activation_trace.role: An eye overpowered by sunlight supplies glare as a failure mode of excessive visibility.
Reflective seeing supplies the needed calibration beyond raw visual exposure.
Deviation from guidance supplies the epistemic consequence of failed calibration.
Sight bewildered by extreme whiteness gives moonlight a possible overload edge.
Confusing or misleading another supplies the branch-distant possibility of apparent light without clarity.
Sun and radiating daylight provide the intense visible medium that can either reveal or overwhelm.

changed_reading.before: More celestial light necessarily means clearer perception.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also prompt calibrated seeing: luminosity reveals, but glare, bewilderment, or apparent brightness can still fail to guide.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation from nur as blossom and siraj as beautification, reinforced by gardens and human germination. It remains anchored in the two focus predicates and produces a coherent upper/lower growth mirror. Downstream prose must mark it as a vegetal aesthetic resonance, not a botanical description of the moon or sun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Nur as blossom and siraj as beautifying radiance let the paired luminaries resemble a bloom in the upper layers.

activation_trace.role: A garden hidden by trees supplies the terrestrial canopy that the heavens can echo.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the lower growth process mirrored above.
Tree blossom and bloom turn lunar light into the exploratory upper flower.
Beautifying as with a lamp gives the solar member an aesthetic growth-like function.

changed_reading.before: The heavens contain two engineered light sources.
changed_reading.after: At branch distance, the upper layers bloom with lunar light and solar beauty, mirroring gardens and human growth from the lower earth.

strongest_changes: The moon/sun pair became a cosmic analogue for address across night/day and public/secret channels.
The repeated ja'ala exposed a design conflict between luminous provision and the community's counter-design of blocked reception.
Rain, extension, layering, growth, return, and extraction turned the focus from static astronomy into a provisioning and phase-marking hinge.
Lamp, earth-carpet, broad roads, and house scaled the focus into a furnished and traversable dwelling.
The later drowning-to-fire reversal gave the nur/siraj field a carefully contained illumination-versus-combustion polarity.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations came from exact repeated constructions and material branch images: ja'ala linked cosmic assignment to human counter-making; binary communication modes activated the two luminaries; and lamp, cover, blossom, saddle, carpet, road, water, and fire branches generated distinct mechanisms without forcing a single final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from luminosity to ecological provisioning and from luminaries to phase regulation are reader inferences; the sequence may instead be a catalogue of independent signs.
The covering model may organize genuine functional contrasts, but some of its force can be explained by cross-root polysemy alone.
The packet's shared mapping for focus nur and later nar supports comparison but does not erase their different forms or contexts.
Saddle, restiveness, misleading light, glare, and blossom are intentionally branch-distant outliers and require explicit qualification downstream.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The two lights are assigned differentiated functions.** **ج ع ل B002** supplies making something into a state, **ق م ر B001** moon and moonlight, **ن و ر B001** illumination, **ش م س B001** sun and radiance, and **س ر ج B001** shining lamp. The repeated *jaʿala* balances moon/light against sun/lamp without making them identical. The packet supplies the paired placement; the abductive arrow is that ordered creation distributes kinds of illumination by role. The ayah reads as functional arrangement rather than ornamental description.

2. **Illumination and punitive fire are branches of one root-domain.** Here **ن و ر B001** supplies light; in 71:25 the packet assigns *nāran* to the same root, where **ن و ر B002** supplies burning fire. The packet gives the lexical recurrence and the later judgment. The inferred relation is that light received as a sign guides, while the same luminous domain encountered after refusal burns. The fixed ayah consequently carries a latent alternative between illumination and fire without merging their distinct branches.

3. **The solar lamp is a beacon within the surah’s path system.** **س ر ج B001** extends the lamp to guidance, and **ن و ر B005** supplies beacon and road landmark. Later 71:19–20 makes earth a spread for traversing broad paths. The packet supplies lamp, landmark branch, and routes; the abductive arrow is that cosmic light enables orientation within the created path-space. The ayah reads as navigational provision as well as celestial display.

4. **Cosmic steadiness exposes human restiveness.** **ش م س B002** supplies restive refusal and difficult temper, activated by the audience’s flight, persistence, and pride in 71:6–7. The direct referent remains the sun through **B001**. The inferred contrast is that the sun accepts its assigned lamp-role while the humans addressed resist theirs. This gives the sun a latent obedience contrast without personifying it as an explicit agent.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:19–20 made the beacon function concrete by supplying a spread earth and broad routes requiring orientation. 71:25 was the strongest surprise: the packet’s shared **ن و ر** root converted light’s alternate branch into entered fire.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Differentiated illumination.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن و ر B001` is light and illumination; `س ر ج B001` is a shining lamp, explicitly extensible to the sun; `ج ع ل B002` is assigning something a state or role. **Structural cue:** repeated `جَعَلَ` assigns unlike predicates to moon and sun within the layered heavens. **Assigned role:** moon provides light, while sun is figured as the operative lamp-source. **Abductive move:** I infer functional differentiation from the parallel but non-identical predication. **Reading change:** the two bodies are coordinated instruments of illumination, not redundant ornaments.

2. **Light as route infrastructure.** **Lexical evidence:** dormant `ن و ر B005` is a beacon or landmark; `س ل ك B001`, `س ب ل B001`, and `ف ج ج B001` at 71:20 describe traversing extended, wide routes. **Structural cue:** visible lights precede the earth's paths, and 71:15 explicitly calls for perceptive seeing. **Assigned role:** illumination makes orientation and traversal possible. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies lights and later paths; I infer navigational enablement. **Reading change:** `نورا` and `سراجا` become components of an orienting world, not only sources of brightness.

3. **Assigned order versus assigned allegiance.** **Lexical evidence:** `ج ع ل B002` gives functional assignment; `ت ب ع B001` at 71:21 gives following a person, command, or path. **Structural cue:** cosmic elements keep their assigned roles, while people later assign guidance to figures amplified by wealth and offspring. **Assigned role:** `جعل` establishes a stable order against which misdirected following becomes visible. **Abductive move:** I infer that social disorder consists partly in giving guidance-functions to the wrong objects. **Reading change:** divine making reads as role-allocation that exposes human misallocation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The routes at 71:20 activated the beacon function of dormant `ن و ر B005`, making illumination practical orientation. The following at 71:21 then sharpened the contrast between assigned cosmic roles and socially assigned guidance: visibility does not decide whom people choose to follow.

baseline.text: Ayı onların içinde bir ışık, güneşi de bir kandil yaptı.

findings.text: Ayın ışığı ile daha sonra girilen ateşin aynı kök alanında buluşması, işaret olarak alınan aydınlığın reddedildiğinde yakıcı karşılığa dönüşmesi ihtimalini görünür kılar.
Işığın yol işareti ve kandilin kılavuzluk çağrışımları, sonraki geniş yollar içinde gök cisimlerini yön bulmayı sağlayan bir altyapı haline getirir.
Gök cisimlerine işlev atanması, insanların varlıklı önderlere yanlış kılavuzluk işlevi vermesiyle karşılaştırıldığında toplumsal düzensizliği bir görev yanlışlığı olarak açığa çıkarır.
Güneş kökündeki huysuz ve boyun eğmez olma çağrışımı, düzen içindeki kandil görevi ile insanların direnmesi arasında keşifsel bir karşıtlık kurar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Creation Installs a Layered Canopy and Its Lights
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The upper world is formed as an ordered, superposed structure whose luminous bodies are placed as functional fixtures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cosmos is simultaneously architecture, matched stack, optical field, and furnished interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measured parts are matched into superposed tiers
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A maker estimates and forms multiple overhead units, then aligns and stacks them into a coherent whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior measure and estimation (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); origination of a created thing (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); completed proportioned form (`quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`); making and bringing into being (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); placing into a condition (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); sevenfold number and multiplication (`quranic:root_000669:B001/m01`); overhead sky and ceiling (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); layers placed one above another (`quranic:root_000927:B002/m01`); one surface covering its counterpart (`quranic:root_000927:B001/m01`); correspondence and fit (`quranic:root_000927:B003/m01`); transition from state to state (`quranic:root_000927:B004/m01`); ranked class or stratum (`quranic:root_000927:B005/m01`); smooth level surface (`quranic:root_000434:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The tiers are not merely numerous. Measure supplies dimensions, completed form supplies bounded units, matching supplies fit, and superposition supplies architecture. The sevenfold upper world is a deliberately assembled stack.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Creation Installs a Layered Canopy and Its Lights
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The upper world is formed as an ordered, superposed structure whose luminous bodies are placed as functional fixtures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cosmos is simultaneously architecture, matched stack, optical field, and furnished interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Moon and sun are installed as differentiated fixtures
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Distinct luminous objects are placed within the layered structure to perform complementary lighting functions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: placing and assigning function (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); moon and its light (`quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`); illumination (`quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`); sun and its radiance (`quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`); luminous lamp (`quranic:root_000693:B001/m01`); visible elevated object (`quranic:root_000745:B002/m01`); direct visual apprehension (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); showing a thing so another sees it (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Placement turns light into furnishing. The moon supplies reflected nocturnal visibility, the sun supplies direct radiance, and the lamp image makes luminosity an installed service within the larger structure. Seeing is the human operation matched to that arrangement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Light Can Guide Sight or Capture It
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Visibility is an active relation: light may reveal an orienting sign, overwhelm perception, or manufacture a persuasive appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same optical field contains landmark, glare, nocturnal hunter, cosmetic enhancement, false lamp, and consuming fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Illumination makes landmarks and routes legible
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Light reveals forms and elevated markers by which an observer can orient thought and movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: direct visual apprehension (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); reflective judgment and deliberation (`quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`); reciprocal visibility between facing sides (`quranic:root_000531:B004/m01`); visible aspect and mirror (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); raised banner (`quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`); showing a thing to another (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); interrogative summons to notice (`quranic:root_000531:B013/m01`); luminous moon (`quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`); illumination (`quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`); visible beacon or boundary marker (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`); luminous lamp (`quranic:root_000693:B001/m01`); sun and daylight (`quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`); two celestial stars named as vultures (`quranic:root_001496:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Vision, reflection, mirror, banner, beacon, moon, sun, and lamp occupy one orienting scene. Light makes a sign available; a sign gives sight a target; and sight becomes deliberative rather than merely sensory. Celestial luminosity thus supports both wayfinding and recognition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Light Can Guide Sight or Capture It
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Visibility is an active relation: light may reveal an orienting sign, overwhelm perception, or manufacture a persuasive appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same optical field contains landmark, glare, nocturnal hunter, cosmetic enhancement, false lamp, and consuming fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Glare and nocturnal exposure turn the observer into prey
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Excess or badly situated light confuses sight, prevents rest, and exposes a subject to hunters or hostile force.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hunting by moonlight (`quranic:root_001255:B003/m01`); sight bewildered by intense whiteness (`quranic:root_001255:B005/m01`); wakefulness under moonlight (`quranic:root_001255:B009/m01`); property left unguarded at night (`quranic:root_001255:B011/m01`); refractory animal or hostile disposition (`quranic:root_000818:B002/m01`); open hostility (`quranic:root_000818:B003/m01`); withholding what lies behind one's back (`quranic:root_000818:B006/m01`); flight and instability (`quranic:root_001564:B006/m01`); enmity between groups (`quranic:root_001564:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Light no longer simply serves the viewer. It blinds, keeps the subject awake, exposes unattended property, and gives the night hunter an advantage. The optical relation reverses: what should reveal the path can make the observer visible to a hostile gaze.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Light Can Guide Sight or Capture It
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Visibility is an active relation: light may reveal an orienting sign, overwhelm perception, or manufacture a persuasive appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same optical field contains landmark, glare, nocturnal hunter, cosmetic enhancement, false lamp, and consuming fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Manufactured brilliance can pass for truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Surface enhancement, display, and false luminosity create an attractive but unreliable appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: beautifying and brightening a face or object (`quranic:root_000693:B003/m01`); false lamp and lying speech (`quranic:root_000693:B005/m01`); gambling victory by deception (`quranic:root_001255:B007/m01`); action performed to be seen (`quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`); cosmetic coating (`quranic:root_001564:B009/m01`); smoke pigment used as kohl or tattoo (`quranic:root_001564:B008/m01`); ochre coating (`quranic:root_001438:B004/m01`); fabricated speech (`quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`); fire and branding flame (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cosmetic brightness and ostentatious display can simulate disclosure while hiding fabrication. The false lamp joins verbal invention to optical persuasion, and the same fire that lends brilliance can brand or consume. This gives the polemic a precise pressure point: appearance is not self-authenticating.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Human Life Is Planted, Returned, and Raised
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human existence follows a cultivated cycle of placement in earth, growth, return, and renewed emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Agriculture, burial, education, and biological descent become phases of one generative process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The earth is a growing medium for human formation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cultivator places living material in receptive ground, tends it, and brings a formed human subject to maturity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: soft fertile earth (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); plant emerging from ground (`quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`); deliberate planting (`quranic:root_001465:B002/m01`); source and growing site (`quranic:root_001465:B005/m01`); human growth and upbringing (`quranic:root_001465:B006/m01`); grain spike extending from the stalk (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); tree flower as emitted light (`quranic:root_001564:B004/m01`); seed covered by soil (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); fruit enclosed in its sheath (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); origination (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); gradual repair and completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Earth supplies setting and material receptivity; planting supplies agency; seed-covering supplies protected latency; and upbringing extends cultivation into human care. “Growing you” therefore remains biologically, pedagogically, and spiritually active.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] The Plot Is Cultivated Beneath a Treated Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A destructive plan develops through hidden preparation, managed inputs, and a surface that conceals the condition of what is ripening underneath.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Plotting becomes an agricultural and cosmetic operation: water the hard ground, grow the plant, coat the exterior, and discover rot in the fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Managed growth can culminate in rotten yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hard ground is watered, a named plant is raised, and apparently successful cultivation terminates in spoiled fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: watering hard earth before cultivation (`quranic:root_001438:B005/m01`); irrigated plant or tree (`quranic:root_001438:B003/m01`); rotten ripe date (`quranic:root_001438:B006/m01`); date spoiled by cold before ripening (`quranic:root_001255:B004/m01`); waterskin spoiled under moonlight (`quranic:root_001255:B006/m01`); deliberate planting (`quranic:root_001465:B002/m01`); plant emerging from ground (`quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`); seed covered with earth (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); fruit enclosed in its sheath (`quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`); palm heart or shoot (`quranic:root_001286:B006/m01`); fertile ground (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The cultivation is technically competent but teleologically corrupt. Watering, planting, seed-cover, and fruit-sheath all support growth, yet the final yield is rotten. This reframes the “great plot” as sustained investment in an outcome whose decay is internal to the process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Cult Objects Bind Affection to Fabrication and Predation

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cult object moves from plastered artifact and cherished name to beak, claw, thief, and raiding detachment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Material is formed into an object, designated as a deity, and made the stationary center of repeated circling.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The object has maker, material, name, theological status, and ritual use. Plaster gives it a fabricated body; designation gives it identity; circling gives it a social center; and invented narrative secures its prestige. The scene sharply distinguishes manufactured centrality from inherent divinity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An idol gains social force by being made, named, loved, circled, and endowed with a predatory persona.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cult object moves from plastered artifact and cherished name to beak, claw, thief, and raiding detachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The vulture figure becomes a machinery of seizure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A predatory bird strips flesh with its beak, scales up into a raiding troop, and finally appears as a thief taking by stealth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: snatching and stripping bit by bit (`quranic:root_001496:B001/m01`); predatory vulture (`quranic:root_001496:B002/m01`); tearing beak (`quranic:root_001496:B004/m01`); cavalry or troop that uproots what it meets (`quranic:root_001496:B005/m01`); thief who takes by stealth (`quranic:root_001496:B008/m01`); fraudulent victory in gambling (`quranic:root_001255:B007/m01`); circulating but unreliable report (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); false attribution and invented claim (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); abandonment and waste (`quranic:root_000760:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Beak, stripping action, troop, and thief share a single predatory invariant at increasing scales. Fraudulent play and false report provide social tools for the same seizure. The idol that is cherished as a protector is lexically reframed as an extraction system.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını tek bir betimleyici anlam olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu üç kurucu niteliği doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç nitelik birlikte kurucudur; yalnız kısa, yalnız şişman veya yalnız inatçı olan biri bu dalın tam kapsamına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın betimleyici kullanıma dayanır ve özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını anlatan nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Kısa, şişman ve tartışmada inatla direnen kişiyi üç niteliği birlikte taşıyarak betimler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu birleşik kişi betimlemesi tek bir tanıklığa dayanır; kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte verilir.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: kısa, şişman ve inatçı olma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişide beden kısalığı, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte anlatıldığında tam karşılık verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçılığın birlikte bulunması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üç niteliği birlikte taşıyan bir kişiyi doğal cümle içinde nitelemek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi belirleyen üç kurucu niteliğin tümünü birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalın, güçlü ve toplu beden yapısını bildirir, fakat inatçılığı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kısa ve toplu beden yapısına sahip kişiyi betimlemede iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel kısalık ve şişmanlığa davranışsal inatçılığı ekler; komşu dal ise bedensel kalınlık ve gücü öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısalık ve inatçı çekişkenliği şişmanlıkla birlikte zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanda bedenin dolgunlaşıp yağlanmasını anlatır, boy ve huy koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Şişmanlık ve beden dolgunluğu anlam alanında iki dal buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üçlü bir kişi niteliğidir; komşu dal yalnız bedensel dolgunluğu seçer ve farklı canlı türlerine de uygulanabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kısa ve toplu kişi betimi ile genel beden dolgunluğu, üç niteliğin birlikte bulunması koşulunu en açık biçimde ayırır.

Bu dallar tek bir çağdaş çekirdeğe indirgenemeyen belirgin bir çok anlamlılık oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gökteki Ay'ı, onun ışığını ve bu ışıkla aydınlanan geceyi aynı anlam alanında açıkça birleştirir. Ay adının hilalden sonraki günlerde ya da dolunay evresinde kullanılması kaynaklar arasındaki kapsam farkıdır; gök cismi ile ışık çekirdeğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gök cismini ve onun ışığını kapsar; Ay'a benzeyen renkleri ya da yalnızca dolunaydaki tamamlanmayı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, Ay'ın yalın adını ışık, aydınlık gece ve doğma bildiren yapıya bağlı kullanımlardan ayırarak birlikte gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Gökteki Ay ile ondan yayılan ışığı ve bu ışığın geceyi aydınlatmasını anlatır. Bazı kaynaklar Ay adının hilalden sonraki günlerde, bazıları ise özellikle dolunayda kullanıldığını belirtir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, gökte görülen Ay adlı gök cismidir.
Ay'ın ışığı, bu ışıkla aydınlanan gece ve Ay'ın bir topluluk üzerine doğması aynı dala bağlı kullanımlardır.
Ay adının başlangıç sınırı hilalden sonraki birkaç geceyle, belirgin evresi ise dolunayla ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gökteki Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece üzerinde birleşir; adın ayın hangi evresinden itibaren öne çıktığı konusunda hilal sonrası ile dolunay arasında farklı sınırlar verir.

concept_gloss.text: Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece
concept_gloss.applicability: Gök cismi ile ondan gelen ışığın oluşturduğu temel anlam alanını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Gök cismini, onun ışığını ve ışığın geceyi aydınlatmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ay'ın görünür hale gelerek bir topluluğun üzerine doğmasını bildiren kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ay'ın doğup insanlarca görünür hale gelmesi olayını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dolunayın yanında genel tamamlanma ve dolgunluk durumunu da anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da Ay'ın dolunay evresindeki tam ve parlak görünümüyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği Ay adlı gök cismi ve onun ışığıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise bir şeyin tamamlanıp dolmasıdır ve dolunay bunun belirgin bir örneğidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; dolunay ve tamamlanma dalı, Ay'ın kendisiyle belirli evresini karıştırma ihtimali en yüksek olan yararlı karşılaştırmadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القمر السماوي، وضوءه القمراء، والليلة المقمرة أو التي أقمرت، وتسميته بعد الهلال أو عند الامتلاء بحسب نصوص المصادر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hayvan ve bulut betimlemelerinde beyaz, çok açık ya da yeşile çalan bir rengi açıkça tanımlar. Bu nedenle dal genel beyazlık değil, ay ışığına benzetilen ve bağlama göre yeşilimsi olabilen özel bir renk niteliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, Ay'ın kendisini ya da ışığını değil, özellikle hayvanlar ve bulutlar için kullanılan beyazımsı veya yeşile çalan rengi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın renk dalıyla sınırlıdır; ay ışığına ilişkin gece ve aydınlanma kullanımları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Özellikle hayvan ve bulut betimlemelerinde görülen, beyazdan çok açık beyaza uzanan ve kimi anlatımlarda yeşile çalan ay ışığı benzeri bir renktir.

facets.statement: Renk çekirdeği beyaz veya çok açık beyazdır; bazı aktarımlarda yeşile çalan bir ton taşır.
Bu renk eşek, dişi eşek, seçkin deve ve bulut gibi varlıkların niteliği olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar beyazlık üzerinde birleşir; bazı anlatımlar rengi çok açık beyaz olarak verirken bazıları yeşile çalan tonu özellikle belirtir ve kullanım alanını hayvanlarla bulutlara yayar.

concept_gloss.text: ay ışığını andıran beyaz ya da yeşile çalan açık renk
concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanların veya bulutların rengini ay ışığına benzer bir açıklıkla betimlerken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Beyazlık çekirdeğini, yeşilimsi ton olasılığını ve özel renk niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rengin düz beyazdan ayrılan yeşilimsi tonu bağlamda öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beyazımsı açıklığı ve yeşile çalan özel tonu birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her tür nesnedeki genel beyazlığı, beyazlaşmayı ve beyazlatmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı, bir varlığın beyaz veya çok açık renkte görünmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel bir renk tonu ve sınırlı betimleme alanı taşır; komşu dal ise nesne türü ya da ton sınırlaması olmadan beyaz rengin genel adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel beyazlık dalı, bu özel beyazımsı tonu sıradan beyaz renkle karıştırma riskini en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأقمر والقمراء في الحمار والأتان والسحاب والهجان، والقمرة كلون يضرب إلى الخضرة أو البياض الشديد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه جرم القمر نفسه ولا ضوء القمراء إلا بوصفهما أصل التشبيه اللوني.
branches.source_phrase_ar: حمار أقمر أي أبيض (maqayis)؛ القمرة لون الحمار الأقمر وهو لون يضرب إلى الخضرة (ayn;tahdhib)؛ سحاب أقمر وأتان قمراء بيضاء وهجان أقمر (sihah;tahdhib)؛ حمار أقمر على لون القمراء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ay ışığında birine gitmeyi, avcının veya aslanın gece ava çıkmasını, kuş ya da ceylanların görüşünü şaşırtarak onları yakalamayı ve birinin gafletinden yararlanmayı aynı dalda toplar. Verilen çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak anlam genel olarak yönelmek veya avlanmak değildir; ay aydınlığı, gece görüşü ya da hazırlıksız yakalama koşulu korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ay ışığında yaklaşma ve gece avında görüşü şaşırtıp gafil yakalama kullanımlarını kapsar; genel avlanma veya genel aldatma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, birbirine bağlı fakat ayrı yapılardaki ay ışığında yaklaşma, gece ava çıkma ve avın görüşünü şaşırtma kullanımlarını karıştırmadan gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Birine ay ışığında yaklaşmayı veya gece ava çıkmayı anlatır; av bağlamında ışık ya da karanlık yüzünden görüşü şaşan hayvanı hazırlıksız yakalayıp avlama sonucuna uzanır. Bir kişinin gafletinden yararlanıp onu aldatma kullanımı da bu hazırlıksız yakalama çizgisine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ay ışığında gitmek veya yaklaşmak dalın temel gece koşullu kullanımıdır.
Aslanın ya da avcının gece ava çıkması ve avın görüşünü şaşırtarak onu yakalaması özel avcılık gerçekleşmesidir.
Birinin gafletini kollayıp onu hazırlıksız yakalamak veya aldatmak, avcılık görüntüsünden gelişen uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ay ışığında yaklaşma ile gece avını ortak alanda verir; toplu ifade avın görüşünü şaşırtma, gafleti kollama ve aldatma ayrıntılarını da içerir, ancak bunlar genel aldatma anlamına dönüştürülmemelidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi palmiye meyvesinin olgunlaşmadan önce soğuğa uğramasını ve bunun sonucunda tatlılığıyla tadını yitirmesini açık bir neden-sonuç dizisi olarak verir. Dal genel meyve bozulması değil, soğuğun olgunlaşma öncesindeki bu özel etkisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca palmiye meyvesinin olgunlaşmadan önce soğuktan zarar görüp tadını yitirmesini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, palmiye meyvesi ve olgunlaşma öncesi soğuk koşuluna bağlı özel kullanımla sınırlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği para veya mal ortaya konan talih oyununda karşılaşma ve rakibi yenmedir; rakip arama ve hileyle aldatma bununla bağlantılı uzantılardır. Çerçevedeki aldatma unsuru bütün oyun eylemlerinin zorunlu özelliği gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, ortaya değer koyulan talih oyunu, bu oyunda rakip arama ve yenme ile hileli aldatma uzantısını kapsar; her tür risk alma değildir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir değer ortaya koyulan talih oyununda tarafların karşılıklı oynamasıdır.
Bir rakip aramak, onunla karşılaşmak ve oyunda onu yenmek eylem zincirinin özel aşamalarıdır.
Birini hileyle aldatıp ondan üstün çıkmak, oyun çekirdeğinden gelişen fakat her oyunda zorunlu olmayan uzantıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üveyiğe benzeyen veya güvercini andıran belirli bir kuşu tanımlar ve çoğul biçimini verir. Bir aktarım Hicaz'ı kuşun yaşam alanı olarak belirtir; bu ayrıntı kuş kimliğinin çekirdeğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli bir kuş adıdır; genel olarak bütün güvercinleri, bütün üveyikleri veya benzer ad taşıyan başka nesneleri kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı doğrudan ışık, aydınlık ve bir şeyin ışık vermesi üzerinden kurar. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır ve ateşin kendisini, çiçeği ya da yalnızca belirgin bir işareti bu anlama katmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ışık ve aydınlatma anlamını kapsar; ateş, çiçek ve yol işareti ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın ışık ve aydınlatma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; başka yapılara özgü anlamlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Işığın kendisini, bir şeyin ışık vermesini ya da başka bir şeyi aydınlatmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Görmeyi sağlayan aydınlık ve ışık, dalın ad çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Bir şeyin ışık vermesi, aydınlanması veya aydınlatılması eylem alanını oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ışık ve aydınlık anlamında, ayrıca ışık verme ve aydınlatma eylemlerinde birleşir; günün ağarması da aydınlanmanın bağlamsal bir gerçekleşmesi olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: ışık ve aydınlatma

error_profile.preserves: Dalın ışık çekirdeğini ve aydınlatma eylemini birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Işık kazanma ve aydınlık duruma gelme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Işığın ad olarak kullanımı ile başkasını aydınlatma anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kaynağın başka bir nesneye ya da ortama ışık vermesini anlatan geçişli eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Işığın ad anlamını ve kendiliğinden aydınlanma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النار المتقدة، ولا نور الشجر، ولا المنارة والعلامة إلا من جهة الإضاءة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النور الضياء والفعل نار وأنار ونورا وإنارة واستنار أي أضاء (ayn)؛ النور: الضياء؛ أنار الشئ واستنار بمعنى أي أضاء؛ التنوير: الإنارة؛ التنوير: الإسفار (sihah)؛ أصل صحيح يدل على إضاءة واضطراب وقلة ثبات؛ النور والنار سميا بذلك من طريقة الإضاءة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yanan ateşi, bu adın ışık ve hızlı hareketle bağlantısını ve hayvanın ateşle yapılan damgasını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çok parçalı yapıyı doğru yansıtır; damga kullanımı ateşin temel tanımına değil, ona bağlı ayrı bir kullanıma yerleştirilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yanan ateş çekirdektir; hayvan damgası ateşle yakma işlemine bağlı özel kullanımdır, yalın ışık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ateş anlamı ile hayvana ait damga ve atasözü yapıları ayrı tutulur; özel yapılar genel ateş anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yanarak ışık ve ısı yayan, hareketli alevleri bulunan ateşi anlatır. Aynı dalda, hayvana ateşle yakılarak yapılan damgaya ve bu damga üzerinden kurulan bir söze bağlı özel kullanımlar da vardır.

facets.statement: Işık veren ve hızlı, kararsız hareket gösteren yanan ateş temel anlamdır.
Hayvan üzerinde ateşle yakılarak oluşturulan damga, ateş çekirdeğine bağlı özel anlamdır.
Hayvanın soyu ile damgasını ilişkilendiren söz, damga anlamına bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yanan ateşi ışık ve hareket niteliğiyle açıklar; çoğul biçimlerini ve hayvanın ateşle yapılan damgasına bağlı kullanımları da aynı dalda toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı ateş yapısını iki yakın fakat özdeş olmayan biçimde açıklar: ateşe yönelmek ve ateşi uzaktan seçmek. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak görme ile yönelmenin birbirine indirgenmemesi gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız ateşle kurulan bu yapıya aittir; uzaktan görme ve ateşe yönelme iki ayrı kaynak açıklamasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız ateş nesnesiyle kurulan yapıya bağlıdır; genel görme, arama veya yönelme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşi uzaktan seçmeyi veya ateşe doğru yönelmeyi anlatan yapıdır. Uzaktan görme ile yönelme, aynı yapı için verilen iki yakın kaynak açıklaması olarak ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Uzakta bulunan ateşi görüp seçmek, yapının algısal açıklamasıdır.
Ateşe doğru yönelmek, aynı yapının amaç ve hareket bildiren kaynak açıklamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak açıklamaları aynı ateş yapısını uzaktan görme ile ateşe yönelme arasında konumlandırır; bu iki açıklama birleştirilmeden aynı kullanım çevresinin parçaları olarak korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uzakta görünen ateşin fark edilmesi ve gözle seçilmesi öne çıktığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kümeyi önce ayrı bir ses yapısı altında açıklık ve çıkıntı ilkesiyle kurar; yol oluğu, kumaş işareti, boyunduruk ve iki kat güç örneklerini verir. Aynı kaynak bunun incelenen köke dönmesinin mümkün olduğunu yalnız ihtimal olarak söyler, bu yüzden dal korunur ancak kök bağı kesin gösterilemez.
